programs.title: 5 Star Getaways
programs.desc: This series is a sun-filled invitation to travel and visit magnificent all-inclusive 5 star resorts throughout the world, their magnificent surroundings and the exciting excursions one can do at each destination.

programs.title: Global Passport
programs.desc: From the crumbling walls of colonial cities, to the beaches facing both the Pacific and the Caribbean oceans, Colombia is bold, bright and beautiful, bringing in discerning travelers by the thousands.

programs.title: Top Travel
programs.desc: Janez and Jeannie visit Soweto, one of the most artistic areas of South Africa; then the duo heads to the Madikwe Hills Private Game Lodge.

programs.title: Travel in Style
programs.desc: Hotels that are fit for a prince or princess in the passionate and warm locale of Monaco; Venice, Italy's largest urban car-free area, features 15th century buildings and ancient courtyards.

programs.title: Private Islands
